summary.text: Cameron Sexton is a Republican state representative who has represented Tennessee House of Representatives District 25 since 2010 and has served as Speaker of the House since August 23, 2019; he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Cameron Sexton was born on November 11, 1970, in Lake City, Tennessee, and received a degree in public administration from the University of Tennessee in 1994.
He worked at Cumberland County Bank in business development and served on the bank's board of directors.

Sexton was first elected to the House in 2010, served as House Republican Caucus Chairman and as Majority Whip, and was elected speaker on August 23, 2019, to replace Glen Casada after Casada resigned.
Sexton and his wife, Lacey, have two children and live in Crossville, Tennessee.
